Public Function Go(ByVal which As Long, ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0: s = Case0(wb)
    Case 1: s = Case1(wb)
    Case 2: s = Case2(wb)
    Case 3: s = Case3(wb)
    Case 4: s = Case4(wb)
    Case 5: s = Case5(wb)
    Case 6: s = Case6(wb)
    Case 7: s = Case7(wb)
    End Select
    Err.Clear
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs path, 51
    s = s & " save=" & Err.Number
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Go = s
End Function

Private Function Case0(wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim tp As CustomXMLPart, tn As CustomXMLNode, k As Sink
    Dim p As Object, n As Object, b As Variant, s As String, v As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    Set p = ActiveWorkbook.CustomXMLParts.Add("<r><d>a b</d><e>6</e></r>")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "[" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description & "]"
    Err.Clear
    Set n = p.SelectSingleNode("/r/d")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "[" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description & "]"
    Err.Clear
    n.AppendChildSubtree "<s><u/></s>"
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "[" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description & "]"
    Err.Clear
    v = Empty
    v = Replace(Replace(Replace(p.DocumentElement.Text, " ", "_"), vbCr, "~"), vbLf, "^")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description Else s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Err.Clear
    v = Empty
    v = Replace(Replace(Replace(n.Text, " ", "_"), vbCr, "~"), vbLf, "^")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description Else s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Err.Clear
    v = Empty
    v = Replace(Replace(Replace(p.XML, " ", "_"), vbCr, "~"), vbLf, "^")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description Else s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Err.Clear
    v = Empty
    v = n.ChildNodes.Count
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description Else s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Err.Clear
    v = Empty
    v = n.LastChild.NodeType
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description Else s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Err.Clear
    v = Empty
    v = Replace(Replace(Replace(n.ChildNodes(1).NodeValue, " ", "_"), vbCr, "~"), vbLf, "^")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description Else s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Err.Clear
    v = Empty
    v = Replace(Replace(Replace(n.LastChild.XML, " ", "_"), vbCr, "~"), vbLf, "^")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description Else s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Case0 = s
End Function

sink:
Public WithEvents p As CustomXMLPart
Public WithEvents ps As CustomXMLParts
Public log As String

Private Function Nm(n As Object) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Nm = "?"
    If n Is Nothing Then Nm = "-" Else Nm = n.BaseName & ":" & n.NodeType
End Function

Private Sub p_NodeAfterDelete(ByVal OldNode As CustomXMLNode, ByVal OldParentNode As CustomXMLNode, ByVal OldNextSibling As CustomXMLNode, ByVal InUndoRedo As Boolean)
    log = log & "D(" & Nm(OldNode) & "," & Nm(OldParentNode) & "," & Nm(OldNextSibling) & "," & InUndoRedo & ")"
End Sub

Private Sub p_NodeAfterInsert(ByVal NewNode As CustomXMLNode, ByVal InUndoRedo As Boolean)
    log = log & "I(" & Nm(NewNode) & "," & InUndoRedo & ")"
End Sub

Private Sub p_NodeAfterReplace(ByVal OldNode As CustomXMLNode, ByVal NewNode As CustomXMLNode, ByVal InUndoRedo As Boolean)
    log = log & "R(" & Nm(OldNode) & "," & Nm(NewNode) & "," & InUndoRedo & ")"
End Sub

Private Sub ps_PartAfterAdd(ByVal NewPart As CustomXMLPart)
    log = log & "A(" & NewPart.NamespaceURI & ")"
End Sub

Private Sub ps_PartAfterLoad(ByVal Part As CustomXMLPart)
    log = log & "L(" & Part.NamespaceURI & ")"
End Sub

Private Sub ps_PartBeforeDelete(ByVal OldPart As CustomXMLPart)
    log = log & "B(" & OldPart.NamespaceURI & ")"
End Sub
